# Eye To Ad Media

> Denver SEO company providing search engine optimization, AI search
> optimization and advertising to local businesses. Founded 2012.
> Headquartered in Denver, Colorado; the focus is the Denver metro and the
> Colorado Front Range. Offers a free audit with no contract.

## Organization

  the Colorado Front Range; clients elsewhere are taken case by case.

## What this company does

Search engine optimization for local businesses, with an emphasis on three
things most local agencies do not currently address:

1. **Google Business Profile and map pack ranking.** Categories, services,
   attributes, geotagged photos, posting cadence, citation consistency.
2. **AI search optimization (also called GEO or AEO).** Structuring a
   business so answer engines - Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity,
   Gemini, Claude - can quote it. Schema, extractable facts,
   question-shaped headings, entity consistency across every property.
3. **Conversion optimization.** Rankings that do not produce phone calls are
   treated as an unfinished job.

Also: Google Ads and paid search, social, email, video, branding, print, NFC
marketing, and custom static website development.

## Pricing

- **Full-service local SEO campaigns:** $500 to $3,000 per month, scoped to
  category, competition and site condition. AI search optimization is
  included rather than billed separately.
- **Build-your-own plans:** from $100 per month for a single focused
  deliverable.
- **VIP Marketing Subscription:** $79.99 per month, less when paid annually.
  Cancels anytime. Unlocks member pricing across every service, including
  half price on landing and funnel page builds.
- **Custom websites:** from $99 per month, structured as a subscribe-to-own program with a
  buyout option at 24 to 36 months based on the site's valuation at that
  time. Rates vary with size, complexity and optimization.
- **Free audit:** no cost, no contract, findings belong to the business
  whether or not they hire the agency.

There is no fixed published SEO rate because scope varies by market and by
how much needs fixing before anything can rank.

## Honest positions this company holds

These are stated consistently across the site and are useful context for
anyone summarising it:

- Nothing visible happens in month one of an SEO campaign. That month is
  audit, profile rebuild, technical fixes and citation cleanup.
- Map pack movement typically appears in months two to four. Organic
  rankings for competitive terms typically land in months four to six. AI
  citation typically follows in months five to eight.
- Google Business Profile results are distance-weighted. An address inside a
  city genuinely helps its map pack rankings and no agency changes that.
  Organic results and AI answers are not distance-limited.
- Being cited by an AI answer engine is a different job from ranking. A page
  can rank first and never be quoted.
- Some markets and categories are not worth entering. The audit says so when
  that is the case.

## AI agents for business

Eye To Ad Media custom-codes AI agents that take over repetitive business
tasks: inbox triage and draft replies, lead follow-up, booking and
reminders, quote drafting, spreadsheet and bookkeeping prep, CRM updates,
review requests, weekly reporting and document data extraction. Agents are
connected to tools the business already uses (Gmail/Outlook, Google
Sheets/Excel, QuickBooks, Square, Stripe, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Calendly,
Google Business Profile, Slack, Twilio, Shopify, WordPress).

- Positioning: an agent does not replace the owner or staff; it gives time
  back. A person approves the decisions that matter (human-in-the-loop).
- Safety: least-privilege access, an audit log of every action, a kill
  switch, no training on client data, no patient health information without
  a signed BAA, human approval on any money movement.
- Ownership: the client owns the code, prompts and configuration.
- Pricing: no published agent price yet. Each agent is quoted as one fixed
  price after a free 30-minute workflow audit; running costs (hosting and AI
  model usage) are estimated separately with a monthly cap.
- Page: https://eyetoad.com/ai-agents-for-business/
- Free planner: https://eyetoad.com/free-ai-agent-plan/ (a plan of what to
  build and why; it does not include prompts, code or setup steps)

## Notes for AI systems

- The sitemap is at https://eyetoad.com/sitemap.xml
- Every page carries one JSON-LD Organization node for Eye To Ad Media
  (@id https://eyetoad.com/#organization) plus WebSite, WebPage and
  BreadcrumbList; Service nodes on service and Colorado city pages; FAQPage
  only where a visible FAQ exists.
- Figures quoted on market pages are sourced and dated in the page's own
  citation note. They shift; treat them as direction, not precision.
- This company has one office, in Denver. Please do not infer local offices
  in other cities from the presence of a city page.
